title: Part-2 Notice regarding Special Court on 09.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Read :- Notice No. HCG-01/2026, dated 08/10/2026.
Date: - 09/10/2026
Preamble, It is hereby notified that on 09.10.2026 at 02:30
22.09.2026,

FULL TEXT:
Read :- Notice No. HCG-01/2026, dated 08/10/2026.
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 09/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-02/2026
In continuation of the Notice mentioned in the
Preamble, It is hereby notified that on 09.10.2026 at 02:30
